rewrite_tone.response:
Here are three ways to rewrite this, depending on the level of firmness you want to convey.

### Option 1: Firm and Direct (Recommended)
This version is best if you want to maintain a serious tone and ensure they understand the gravity of the situation without sounding emotional.

**Subject:** Urgent: Status Update Required for Item #A-118

Dear [Vendor Name],

I am writing to follow up on the delivery of Item #A-118 ($2,140), which was scheduled to arrive yesterday. 

As this is the second delivery delay we have experienced this quarter, we need to ensure this shipment arrives no later than this Thursday. Please be advised that if the item is not received by Thursday, we will be forced to move forward with cancelling our contract.

Please provide an immediate update on the status of this delivery.

Best regards,

[Your Name]

***

### Option 2: Concise and Executive
This version is best for a quick, high-level communication that gets straight to the point.

**Subject:** Delivery Delay: Item #A-118

Dear [Vendor Name],

We have not yet received Item #A-118 ($2,140), which was due yesterday. This marks the second late delivery this quarter.

We require this item to be delivered by Thursday. If this deadline cannot be met, we will proceed with the cancellation of our contract. We look forward to your prompt response regarding the shipment status.

Regards,

[Your Name]

***

### Option 3: Collaborative but Serious
Use this version if you have a long-standing relationship with the vendor and want to give them one last chance to "fix" the relationship before the contract is terminated.

**Subject:** Follow-up regarding Item #A-118

Dear [Vendor Name],

I am reaching out regarding the delivery of Item #A-118 ($2,140), which missed its scheduled delivery date of yesterday. 

Because this is the second delay we have encountered this quarter, we are at a critical point regarding our agreement. We need this item in hand by Thursday to avoid the cancellation of our contract. 

Please let us know as soon as possible when we can expect the delivery.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
